title: An Entire Country Switched Driving Sides Overnight 🚗
caption:
A whole country switched to the other side of the road overnight 🚗
Wait for the ending 👀

True story. On 3 September 1967, "Dagen H", Sweden switched from driving on the left to driving on the right. Traffic was halted in the early morning while every car changed sides, and accidents went down at first.
Could your country pull this off? 👇
first_comment: Imagine your whole country changing lanes at once. Now imagine your uncle doing it. 🚗👇
